headline: DigiCert admits lengthy breach exposed customer data
summary: DigiCert said a botched server migration exposed an internal system to the internet, giving unauthorized access to customer information and identity documents for roughly 16 months before the company noticed.

claims.statement: DigiCert suffered a data breach after a server migration mistakenly exposed an internal system, allowing unauthorized access to customer information and identity documents.

sources.quote: DigiCert data breach exposes customer information, identity documents

DigiCert warns it suffered a data breach after a server migration mistakenly exposed an internal business system to the internet, allowing unauthorized access to customer information and identity documents.

claims.statement: The exposure lasted roughly 16 months before DigiCert noticed.

sources.quote: DigiCert admits 16-month security lapse exposed customer information
DigiCert took months to notice someone had wandered in
